channel.title: Bandwidth incidents — Vendor Status Watch

item.title: Bandwidth Local Market Impairment - 638 - Bismarck, ND [investigating]
item.description: We are experiencing an impairment on the Bandwidth network which may affect a portion of calls. We are currently working with our carrier for resolution.

item.title: STIR/SHAKEN Signing Incident [resolved]
item.description: For a short period of time calls were not being signed with regards to STIR/SHAKEN. No call failure were observed with this incident. Proper call signing has been restored.

item.title: Toll Free Porting Incident [resolved]
item.description: For a brief period of time, some Toll Free port orders were delayed in provisioning due to network condition with a industry partner. At this time provisioning activities are processing as expected.

item.title: Toll Free Origination Incident [resolved]
item.description: For a brief period of time, a sub-set of Toll Free Origination voice traffic was unable to complete due to an off-network incident. This incident has been resolved and we are observing expected network behavior.

item.title: Outbound Voice Call Routing Incident [resolved]
item.description: For a brief period of time a subset of customer traffic, with a specific account settings were until not route traffic as expected. Teams have resolved this incident and are observing expected traffic behaviors.

item.title: Bandwidth App Incident - New Number Orders [resolved]
Bandwidth App Number Order Incident [resolved]
item.description: For a brief period of time, number orders in the Bandwidth App were delayed or failed to complete. This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Off Net Port Order Activation Delays [resolved]
RCS Agent Locations Incident [resolved]
item.description: Bandwidth teams resolved an incident where RCS Agents were deployed to the incorrect region resulting in potential traffic issues.

item.title: Bandwidth App Incident - Number Order [resolved]
item.description: For a brief period of time new telephone number orders were delayed in processing. At this time, orders are processing as expected, and we consider this incident resolved.

item.title: ATL Datacenter Incident [resolved]
item.description: For a brief period of time, a sub-set of traffic transiting over porting of our ATL datacenter may have unexpectedly failed to complete as intended. At this time this portion of traffic has restored and our network is operating as expected.
